in_hebrew.name: Horst
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Stallion, strong one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Horst הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German word hruotist, meaning 'stallion' or 'strong one'. The name Horst has been popular in Germany and other Germanic-speaking regions for centuries. It is a name that conveys strength, power, and vitality.
